# Example skills

The fixture's stand-in for `.claude/skills/README.md` — the one README §4 step 5's own glob
`.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md` **structurally cannot** match, because that pattern matches a
manifest and never the directory's own index. It is the first of the six READMEs
`docs/plans/2026-09-02-w37-rfc-readme-row-and-stamp-set.md` §4 adds to the stamp set.
